name: Tino Thompson
source:
Tino is a state investigator, making his first and only appearance in Chapter 14 to take over the case and bring [spoiler]Chief Walsh and Margaret Sterling[/spoiler] into his custody. [spoiler]Before he can do this he is murdered by [url=/c135213/]Jeff Duffy[/url], who then proceeds to kill Tino's two prisoners and kidnap [url=/c134904/]Kate O'Malley[/url], declaring his intention to murder her as well.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Veil_of_Secrets_Miscellaneous_Characters]Wiki[/url]]
